assumptions.assumption: Greenfield: project dir contains only walteur-kit/run-trace.jsonl (WALTEUR harness trace) — no app source, package.json, or framework config, so nothing to preserve or integrate.
Single-user, single-browser, single-tab; no cross-tab or cross-device sync expected.
Persistence = browser localStorage only (one key, JSON-serialized). No IndexedDB, no server.
'node:test suite covering the pure state logic' is read literally: tests target a DOM-free logic module, NOT the DOM/UI — so no jsdom dependency is introduced (keeps zero-dep constraint).
App must be runnable with no install/build (open index.html or serve statically); package.json exists only to expose `node --test` and is not required to run the app.
Filters are the three named states — all / active / done — with no persisted filter selection required across reload unless trivially free.
'Edit' means in-place edit of an existing task's text (Enter to commit, Escape to cancel); reordering is out of scope.

Accessibility target is WCAG 2.1 AA-oriented best practices (semantic elements, keyboard operability, ARIA roles/labels, aria-live status) verified by manual/code review — no automated axe/E2E gate is required to ship.
Node 18+ on the dev host (node:test is stable there); ESM used throughout so the same state module loads in browser and in node:test.
Modern evergreen browser target (localStorage + ES modules); no IE/legacy transpile needed.
Success = keyboard-only operability of every action with correct announced state + localStorage round-trip + green node:test suite; visual polish is secondary.
